corrections.reason: The word printed is ሽም (6th order ሽ in the archaic idiom 'ሽም አውጣን አውጣን አሉ' meaning 'though they resisted sleep as much as they could'), not ሸም.
Ge'ez word for 'and the two men' is ወዕደውኒ (with ዕ, matching Col 1 L11 ዕደው), visually clear as circular ዕ rather than triangular እ.
The printed text on the page clearly has the conjunction 'ወ' before 'ሎቱ' ('ወሎቱ ስምዕዎ').
Classical Ge'ez verb is ወያዋግቦ (with 4th order ዋ, straight leg without a 3rd-order foot) and on L36 ወታዋግበክሙ.
Classical Ge'ez citation has 4th order ዋ ('ወታዋግበክሙ ዕለት እኪት'), matching the visual glyph with a single vertical stem.
